name: HOME
problem: Within two seconds, know how to start either intention and which real obligation needs attention.
gap: Discovery hierarchy; personal attention; one-account navigation; empty and active states.

name: TASK_CARD
problem: Know enough scope, place, time and actual amount to decide whether to open the task.
gap: Two further real job/service cards with long text, no photo and uncertain price.

name: TASK_DETAIL
problem: Understand work, requirements, timing, public location and trust before making an offer.
gap: Real service detail and offer-entry transition; changed terms and missing facts.

name: MAP
problem: Select an opportunity without losing its location or covering the next action.
gap: Two further real selected-pin/list sequences, including Android; clusters and remote fallback.

name: CREATE_TASK
problem: Turn an imprecise need into a reviewed, intentionally published task.
gap: A complete service-request creation sequence; direct correction; restore/offline behavior.

name: AI_INTERVIEW
problem: Answer one useful question and correct what was understood without losing the draft.
gap: Complete profile interview + review/save sequence; dictation editing and recovery.

name: WORKER_PROFILE
problem: Understand capability, credible evidence, availability and relevance to this task.
gap: Another real provider profile with equipment/radius; no-reviews and many-skills states.

name: REQUESTER_PROFILE
problem: Understand who posted the task and which supported trust signals exist.
gap: Two additional marketplace identity/reputation examples; privacy and sparse profiles.

name: APPLICATION
problem: Make and compare a clear offer with accurate amount, timing and included work.
gap: Real mobile submission and comparable-candidate decision flows; stale offer state.

name: AGREEMENT
problem: Know the accepted terms, current state and next permitted action.
gap: Three real service commitment/change/completion/problem flows from two more sources.

name: CHAT
problem: Read and send messages while retaining task context and honest delivery state.
gap: Two real marketplace threads with attachments and system actions; failed-send recovery.

name: NOTIFICATIONS
problem: Understand what changed and open the correct object.
gap: Three transactional inbox/unread/deep-link flows; full platform permission guidance.

name: REVIEWS
problem: Give an eligible review quickly and understand reputation without invented confidence.
gap: Three real bilateral rating, tag and no-rating examples from another marketplace.

name: AVAILABILITY
problem: See and edit real working intervals, exceptions and invitation readiness.
gap: Recurring week and exception editing in another service marketplace; saved/unsaved behavior.

name: NAVIGATION
problem: Use both intentions in one account and return predictably.
gap: A live multi-intent marketplace transition sequence with Back and retained browsing context.
